user.title: HACS Private Token Manager
user.description: Choose how to give HACS a GitHub token that can read your private repositories.

manual.title: Enter a GitHub token
manual.description: Paste a token that can read your private repositories: a classic token with the 'repo' scope, or a fine-grained token with Contents: Read-only on the repositories you want.

data_description.token: Stored encrypted in the config entry and mirrored into HACS so private custom repositories install and update normally.
data_description.test_repo: Optional owner/name (e.g. owner/your-private-repo). If set, the token is verified to actually read this private repository, not just to authenticate.

reconfigure.title: Update GitHub token
reconfigure.description: Rotate the GitHub token used for private HACS repositories.

progress.wait_for_device:

2. Enter the code:
```
{code}
```

error.invalid_token: GitHub rejected this token, or it cannot read the test repository. Check the token and its repository/Contents permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach GitHub to validate the token. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: HACS Private Token Manager is already set up.
abort.no_client_id: This build has no GitHub OAuth App configured, so browser login is unavailable. Use 'Enter a token manually' instead.
abort.device_flow_disabled: The GitHub OAuth App does not have Device Flow enabled. Enable it in the app settings, then try again.
abort.expired_token: The authorization request expired before it was approved. Please start over.
abort.device_flow_failed: GitHub authorization failed. Please try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach GitHub. Please try again.

pat_invalid.title: GitHub token for private HACS repos is invalid

confirm.title: Update GitHub token
confirm.description: The stored GitHub token is no longer valid (expired or revoked), so HACS can no longer read your private repositories. Paste a new token to restore access.

error.invalid_token: GitHub rejected this token, or it cannot read the test repository.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach GitHub to validate the token. Please try again.

abort.entry_missing: The HACS Private Token Manager entry no longer exists.

hacs_missing.title: HACS is not installed
hacs_missing.description: HACS Private Token Manager keeps HACS authenticated for private repositories, but no HACS integration was found. Install and set up HACS, then reload this integration.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to apply the HACS token

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: Your GitHub token has been stored in HACS, but HACS only reads its token at startup. Restart Home Assistant now to apply it so your private repositories become available in HACS. (You can also restart later from Settings → System.)
